world.title: 泳池焦散光纹
world.posterTitle: 泳池底部不断移动的焦散光纹
world.posterHook: 为什么泳池底下的光一直在游？
world.posterSource: Canvas 2D · 水面折射光线模型 · 本地构建
world.question: 为什么泳池底下的光一直在游？
world.hook: 轻划透明水面，让一圈涟漪重新编织池底的亮线；再沿着光路看清每一道明暗纹路从哪里来。
world.payoff: 起伏的水面像无数片不断转动的软镜片，把进入水中的阳光折向不同方向。许多光线聚到一起的地方变亮，光被带走的地方变暗，于是池底出现游动的光网。

en.title: Caustic light patterns in a pool
en.posterTitle: Moving caustic patterns on a pool floor
en.posterHook: Why does the light on a pool floor keep swimming?
en.posterSource: Canvas 2D · Water-surface refraction model · Local build
en.question: Why does the light on a pool floor keep swimming?
en.hook: Brush the transparent surface and let a ripple reweave the bright lines below, then follow the rays to see where every light and dark patch comes from.
en.payoff: A rippling surface behaves like countless soft lenses that continuously redirect sunlight entering the water. Places where many rays gather become bright; places rays leave behind become dark, creating the moving net on the pool floor.
